Name: infod-solar
Title: High-Resolution Forecasts of Solar Energy Potential
Description:
The data layer *Radiation 100m* shows the global radiation on the real surface for some time steps on 5th march 2026 for the region Baden in a spatial resolution of 100x100m.

*Radiation 1m* shows the same but on a spatial resolution of 1x1m. The radiation data is given in W/m². The *Theoretical Solar Potential 100m* shows the potential on 100x100m, *Theoretical Solar Potential 1m* shows the downscaled potential on 1x1m. 

The calculation of the theoretical solar potential (PVpot) is based on the method of Jerez et al (2015). First, the global solar radiation is calculated with GeoSphere Austria's solar radiation model STRAHLGRID (Seitner et al (2024)). The data of global radiation is provided in 1h temporal and 100m (or 1m) spatial resolution. In combination with temperature and wind data from GeoSphere Austria's INCA model (Haiden et al (2011)) the theoretical solar potential is calculated. 

The theoretical solar potential ranges from 0 to 1. If the value is equal to 1, the nominal PV production value specified by the system is achieved. If the cell temperature of the PV system is higher (lower) than 25°C and/or the global radiation is less (greater) than 1000 W/m², then the PV output is lower (greater) than the nominal power of the module. These threshold values can be adjusted to customer requirements.
